title_en: My friend who feels the cold
jp_sentences: わたしのともだちは、さむがりだ。
秋なのに、もうふゆのふくを着たがっている。
でも、外に出るのがすきで、休みの日はいつも山に行きたがる。
わたしが「今日は、さむいよ」と言っても、元気に歩いていく。
ふゆの山でみんながさむがるのに、ともだちだけは元気だ。
jp: わたしのともだちは、さむがりだ。秋なのに、もうふゆのふくを着たがっている。でも、外に出るのがすきで、休みの日はいつも山に行きたがる。わたしが「今日は、さむいよ」と言っても、元気に歩いていく。ふゆの山でみんながさむがるのに、ともだちだけは元気だ。
translation_pt: Meu amigo é friorento. Ainda é outono e ele já quer usar roupa de inverno. Mas ele gosta de sair e, nos dias de folga, sempre quer ir para a montanha. Mesmo quando eu falo "Hoje está frio", ele sai andando animado. No inverno, na montanha, todo mundo sente frio, e só meu amigo continua animado.
translation_en: My friend really feels the cold. It is still autumn and he already wants to wear winter clothes. But he likes going outside, and on his days off he always wants to head for the mountains. Even when I say "It's cold today", he walks off cheerfully. On the winter mountains everyone feels the cold, and only my friend stays cheerful.
